items.question: How does AvaRamp work?
items.answer: AvaRamp is an automated fiat gateway tailored for Avalanche C-Chain. For on-ramp (buying), scan VietQR with your banking app; our smart engine verifies payment in 5-10 seconds and instantly transfers AVAX or USDC directly to your non-custodial wallet. For off-ramp (selling), send tokens to the escrow contract and VND is instantly wired to your bank.

items.question: Do I need KYC verification?
items.answer: No cumbersome KYC is required for standard daily transactions under 25,000,000 VND (~$1,000 USD). You simply input your Avalanche wallet address, scan the QR code, and receive crypto immediately.

items.question: What are the transaction fees on AvaRamp?
items.answer: AvaRamp charges a flat, ultra-competitive 0.5% fee on both buy and sell orders. There are zero hidden spreads or markup fees. Avalanche C-Chain gas fees are microscopic (< 0.002 AVAX, under $0.05).

items.question: Is AvaRamp non-custodial?
items.answer: Absolutely not. AvaRamp is 100% non-custodial. Cryptocurrencies are dispatched straight from liquidity vaults into your self-custodial wallet (Core Wallet, MetaMask, Rabby). You always maintain total sovereignty over your private keys.

items.question: How fast is the transaction settled?
items.answer: Thanks to Avalanche's sub-second transaction finality and our 24/7 automated banking bridge via VietQR/Napas, typical transactions settle in just 15 to 30 seconds after payment confirmation.

items.question: Can I integrate AvaRamp into my dApp or Avalanche game?
items.answer: Yes! AvaRamp provides an embeddable React widget and developer REST API. Enable fiat checkout inside your DeFi dApp, NFT marketplace, or GameFi project on Avalanche with just a single component tag, plus an attractive partner revenue-sharing model.
